==Usage==
This is an infobox for technical and usage information on various classes of space vehicles. The fields are relevant to starships, fighters, shuttles, and most other spacefaring constructs. For individual examples of a known class, do not use this template. Use {{Tl|IndividualShip}} instead.

For space stations, we are now using {{Tl|SpaceStation}}.

When adding fields to this box, be sure to update [[Template:StarshipClass/preload]] at the same time.

==Instructions==
Cut and paste the following code into your article, then put the relevant specifications after the "=" signs.
<pre class="wrap"><nowiki>{{Top|}}
{{StarshipClass
|image=
|name=
|designer=
|manufacturer=
|line=
|model=
|type=
|cost=
|modifier=
|sysmods=
|length=

==Data fields==
*name &ndash; Simply list the name of the starship class.
*image &ndash; Put a link to the main image which represents the class. If the image is 250 pixels wide or larger, specify an image width of 250 pixels. If the image is smaller than 250 pixels wide, do not specify the size.
*manufacturer &ndash; Put the manufacturer name here
*designer &ndash; Put the name of the person(s) or organization(s) that designed the craft, if different or more specific than manufacturer
*line &ndash; The series of ships the vessel is a member of (if applicable). For example, the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] and the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] are both part of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] line.
*model &ndash; List the full official name of the vessel.
*type &ndash; List the primary design/style classification of the model. For example, the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] has a [[light freighter]] model classification.
*cost &ndash; List the cost of the ship (and the currency type if needed)
*length &ndash; Length of the ship
*width &ndash; Width of the ship
*height &ndash; Height of the ship
*max accel &ndash; Maximum acceleration in "g"
*mglt &ndash; Speed in MGLT -- do not use if "max accel" is known. MGLT is primarily a gameplay mechanic.
*max speed &ndash; Maximum atmospheric speed
*maneuverability &ndash; Maneuverability rating
*engine &ndash; Types of sublight and atmospheric drive systems
*hyperdrive &ndash; Hyperdrive ratings
*hdrange &ndash; Hyperdrive range (in light-years)
*hdsystem &ndash; Hyperdrive system (or "none" if no hyperdrive)
*poweroutput &ndash; Power output in watts (this field will rarely be used)
*power &ndash; Types of power systems
*shield gen &ndash; Type of shield generators (with rating if known)
*hull &ndash; Type of hull materials (with rating if known)
*sensor &ndash; Types of sensor systems
*target &ndash; Types of targeting systems
*navigation &ndash; Navigation computer systems
*avionics &ndash; Avionics/flight control systems
*countermeasures &ndash; ECM and stealth systems
*armament &ndash; List of weaponry equipped
*complement &ndash; Support craft carried aboard
*crew &ndash; Number of crew (with crew breakdown if known)
*skeleton &ndash; Minimum crew required for operation
*passengers &ndash; Number and type of passengers carried
*capacity &ndash; Cargo capacity (be careful, this may overlap with complement and passengers)
*consumables &ndash; Duration of consumable goods stored aboard
*othersystems &ndash; Any systems not listed above
*role &ndash; List what the ship is used for here
*firstuse &ndash; Enter the date the class was introduced
*retired &ndash; Enter the date the class was retired 
*affiliation &ndash; List the governments and major organizations that use the ship here</noinclude>
